in_hebrew.name: אליפלט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליפלט הוא שם עברי שמשמעו אלוהים הוא ישועתי, מורכב משני מרכיבים: אל, שפירושו אלוהים, ופלט, שפירושו ישועה, השם מופיע בתנ״ך כשם של מספר דמויות, והוא נחשב לשם מקובל במסורת הנוצרית

in_greek.name: Ελιφλήτ
in_greek.meaning: ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου
in_greek.long_meaning: ο Ελιφλήτ είναι εβραϊκό όνομα που σημαίνει ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου, αποτελείται από δύο συνιστώσες: Ελι, που σημαίνει Θεός, και Φλήτ, που σημαίνει σωτηρία, το όνομα εμφανίζεται στην Καινή Διαθήκη ως όνομα διάφορων προσωπικοτήτων, και θεωρείται δημοφιλές όνομα στην χριστιανική παράδοση

in_latin.name: Eliphelet
in_latin.long_meaning: Eliphelet est nomen hebraicum quod significat Deus est salus mea, constat ex duobus elementis: El, quod significat Deus, et Phelet, quod significat salus, nomen apparet in Vetere Testamento ut nomen multorum personarum, et habetur pro nomine usuale in traditione christiana

in_english.name: Eliphelet
in_english.long_meaning: Eliphelet is a Hebrew name meaning God is my salvation, derived from two components: El, meaning God, and Phelet, meaning salvation, the name appears in the Bible as the name of several figures, and is considered a popular name in Christian tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name "Eliphelet," derived from the Hebrew word "El," meaning "God," and "Phelet," meaning "My God is he," holds significant cultural importance for those with Christian or Hebrew backgrounds. It serves as a reminder of the belief in the divine power and presence of God in one's life. In Christian tradition, the name Eliphelet can be seen as a reference to the belief in God's sovereignty and protection.
data.spiritual_significance: "Eliphelet" is a powerful name imbued with spiritual significance. It is a name that proclaims faith and trust in God, symbolizing the belief that He is the ultimate authority and protector. In spiritual practices, the name Eliphelet can be used as a mantra or prayer, affirming one's devotion and trust in God. It is a name that embodies the idea that God is the source of all strength and love, and that He is present in every moment of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Eliphelet's name means "My God is abundance" or "God is my abundance." It symbolizes the belief in God's unending provision and generosity.

biblical_reference.note: Eliphelet is listed as one of the sons of David

historical_references.reference: Eliphelet is a name mentioned in the Old Testament, specifically in the book of 1 Chronicles, as the name of a son of Eliab and grandson of Jesse.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Eliphelet continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Eliphelet, a minister in New York, United States, shares that their name Eliphelet meaning "God's my God" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
